twoFactorResetBody: An administrator reset TOTP for your OligInvest account: {issuedAt} (UTC). All sessions have been revoked. Your next sign-in requires TOTP setup again. If you did not request a reset, contact the instance administrator: {privacyUrl}
passwordResetBody:
We received a request to reset your OligInvest password.

Open this link within 30 minutes of the request:
{url}

If you did not send this request, ignore this message. Your password remains unchanged. After a password change, all sessions are revoked. TOTP will still be required when you sign in again.
